subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Lieutanant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Lieutenant"** refers to a military or naval officer ranking just below a captain. (लेफ्टिनेंट)

 
 
• **Example:** The lieutenant gave orders to the soldiers before they marched out on the field.
 
 
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"Lieutenant"**, not "Lieutanant".
 
 
• **Example:** The Lieutenant was promoted after a year of exceptional service.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Lieutanant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bureaucracy** (ब्यूरोक्रेसी): A system of government in which most of the decisions are made by state officials rather than by elected representatives.

 
 
• **Example:** The country’s bureaucracy is known for its complex and slow-moving processes.
 
 
 
• **Rendezvous** (मुलाकात): A meeting or gathering at a prearranged time and place.
 
 
• **Example:** They planned a secret rendezvous at the café to discuss their next move.
 
 
 
• **Augment** (वृद्धि करना): To make something greater by adding to it; increase.
 
 
• **Example:** The company plans to augment its product line by adding more eco-friendly options.
